title: NEW MSFS 2024 Adventures: Alaska 737 Missions, Epic World River Runs & Caribbean Nights!
description:
If you're looking to take your visual exploration and route planning to the next level in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, the marketplace just rolled out a massive wave of curated activities, scenic river expeditions, and guided discovery flights. From flying scheduled mainline 737 runs through the rugged Alaskan wilderness to low-level river navigations across every continent and tropical island hopping, this drop is packed with incredible flying adventures.

In this comprehensive activity and scenery breakdown, we organize this week's marketplace arrivals into clear categories to help you decide what's claiming top priority in your flight log:

✈️ COMMERCIAL AIRLINE & REGIONAL VFR ACTIVITIES
We kick off our journey with the Alaska Airlines America 250 package by Perfect Flight, pairing a commemorative livery for the default Boeing 737 MAX with 12 handcrafted airline missions. You'll navigate challenging legs spanning from the freezing Prudhoe Bay oil fields and isolated Yukon-Kuskokwim Delta communities to Juneau, the British Columbia coastline, and the Inside Passage into Seattle. Then, we look at Perfect Flight’s Discover New Jersey package for general aviation flyers, offering 7 narrated VFR flights with over 100 multilingual audio tour guides covering the Atlantic coastline all the way to Kittatinny Mountain.

🌊 THE WORLD RIVERS EXPEDITION SERIES
Next, we explore Koshi’s acclaimed bush trip series with the massive World River Expeditions lineup. Trace the planet's most iconic waterways from low altitude, including the Amazon, Nile, Yangtze, Danube, Volga, Mississippi, Missouri, Colorado, Ganges, Rhine, Yukon, and Murray rivers. We also break down the marketplace pricing structure, showing why picking up the complete multi-river bundle offers significantly better value than buying individual waterway packs.

🌴 THE CARIBBEAN NIGHTS DISCOVERY SERIES
We wrap up under the sun and stars with Koshi’s Caribbean Nights Discovery series. This expansive collection brings multi-leg tropical island-hopping across the Bahamas, Turks & Caicos, Hispaniola, Puerto Rico, the Cayman Islands, the Lesser Antilles, Mexico, Nicaragua, and Colombia. We inspect what each regional leg offers and highlight the bundle discount so you can get maximum island flying for the best price.

Which of these new expeditions or airline mission packs are you loading up first? Are you taking the 737 MAX into wild Alaska, navigating the world's great rivers, or island hopping across the Caribbean? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you find your next flight adventure in MSFS 2024, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and blue skies on your next flight!
